product: Product 7 - member spectroscopic redshift catalogues for a projected velocity dispersion field sigma(R)
vizier_trap_note: RE-VALIDATED 2026-09-06 under registry rule catalogue_validation v3 (three detectors, ALL required: #Name: echo of the exact request, absence of CatalogsExamined=, and a #Title: author match). The round-1 note below was produced by a client that did NOT perform the echo check it claimed: scripts/vizier.py computed the echo into two unused locals and decided on `nrows > 0 and bool(tables or titles)`, i.e. rule v2, which the registry records as BROKEN. Every contactable identifier in not_found has been re-probed under v3 and NO VERDICT CHANGED; per-entry detector evidence is in each entry's revalidated_v3 block and in velocities/REVALIDATION_v3.json. Eight are genuine absences (five Cooper+2013 fallbacks, three explicit 'Table or Catalog not found'); four are real catalogues that pass all three detectors and were rejected on CONTENT, and each content claim was re-derived from the live table and upheld. J/A+A/709/A254 was NOT contacted (confirmation-reserve token 'granata') and its verdict is carried forward unvalidated. CAVEAT ON EVIDENCE: velocities/raw/ is matched by cluster-data/.gitignore, so no raw probe payload is preserved by the repository. --- ROUND-1 NOTE FOLLOWS --- VERIFIED FOR EVERY VIZIER FILE: the response was checked to echo back '#Name: <exact identifier requested>'. VizieR returns HTTP 200 with a DIFFERENT catalogue (currently J/MNRAS/430/1125) when an identifier does not exist, and returns an explicit '#INFO Error=Table or Catalog not found' for some others; both failure modes were encountered and are recorded in not_found below. Row counts were additionally asserted against the authoritative CDS ReadMe 'Records' column for every catalogue - all matched exactly, so no LaTeX/table-splitting truncation occurred.

not_found.reference: Mercurio et al. 2021, A&A 656, A147, 'CLASH-VLT: Abell S1063. Cluster assembly history and spectroscopic catalogue'
not_found.evidence: VizieR asu-tsv with -source=J/A+A/656/A147 (both raw '+' and URL-encoded %2B) returns HTTP 200 but echoes '#Name: J/MNRAS/430/1125' (Cooper+2013 RMS NIR YSO survey) - the VizieR fallback for a non-existent identifier, NOT the requested table. cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A%2BA/656/A147/ReadMe returns HTTP 404. Round-1 cited raw/probe_J_A+A_656_A147.tsv as its evidence; that file does not exist under any checkout, and velocities/raw/ is gitignored, so no round-1 payload was preserved. Re-probed 2026-09-06 under v3: ABSENT_FALLBACK -- D1 and D2 both fail, CatalogsExamined=10213, J/MNRAS/430/1125 served instead.
not_found.note: The task brief attributed this reference to MACS J0416; it is actually the Abell S1063 catalogue.
